# 🧰 Engineering templates

Use these as working documents, not paperwork for its own sake. Copy a template for a change that needs a written plan, test record, audit, incident review, or release decision. Replace every instruction with project-specific evidence. Delete sections that truly do not apply and explain why; do not fill a document with invented approvals or metrics.
